sheets.prompt: Extend the EXACT existing Pingordy design from the original atlas. 12 sprites in 4 columns x 3 rows. First cell: right-facing side fighting guard, stationary canonical pose. Eight consecutive RIGHT-facing moonwalk frames sliding backward left, 4 columns 2 rows. Left hand trouser pocket. Alternate flat-foot sliding support and raised heel/toe support, exchange legs and loop. Same adult identity, shirt, tie, anatomy and fine pixel palette.

Twelve ultimate dance poses, 4 columns 3 rows: touch headband; sharp shoulder isolation; cross step; forward lean 25 degrees; deeper lean 40 degrees; recover; toe stand; heel pivot; arm point right; dance kick; hand at headband releasing beam; return side guard. Same adult pixel-art identity and body scale. No rendered beam: supplied by game engine.

Eight RIGHT-facing overhead headband whip frames, 4 columns 2 rows: reach knot; pull headband free; raise cloth overhead; wind back; snap cloth down and forward right; follow through; gather cloth to forehead; retie and return guard. No forehead band while held as whip. Same adult body, face, clothes and pixel detail. Cloth attached to hand, no energy effects.

Side guard, crossed-arm block, crouch guard, hurt recoil; high punch, medium sidekick, crouch punch, sweep; jump up, jump down, airborne kick, somersault tuck; landing, lying KO, charge fists down, victory fist up. Same anatomy and pixel design across all actions, crouching naturally shorter, no rendered energy.

Forward grab reach, grab clutch, bent-knee lift, overhead throw release; aerial tuck, sideways acrobatic flip, throw finish, airborne grab reach; headband-touch dance preparation, knee lift, high dance kick, finger-up victory. No opponent or energy drawn. Same adult identity, body scale and fine pixel style.

Production sprites for SAME Pingordy as canonical image. Row one: four coherent power-charge poses, wide bent-knee stance, fists at waist, determined shout, chest expansion and tightening fists. Row two: high rising kick with back three-quarter view and straight raised leg; hovering dance kick with bent legs and crossed forearms; rightward speed dash leaning forward with trailing fist; victorious crossed-arm one-toe stance with raised knee. Exactly eight sprites, four columns two rows, transparent. Same slim adult Pingordy identity and detailed 16-bit pixel art.
